g.text: everything here is bounded by the inbound's handshake_timeout, then relayed
The same layers on a proxy outbound: one dialer, built once, used per connection
holds only its own goroutine and slot; the handshake
timeout closes it. Other clients never wait.
is logged at Debug and closed (scanners do this all
day); a wrong ws path first gets a 404.
Fallback recording starts above the overlays

TLS and WebSocket, not TLS records.
